independent_method: Separate read-only audit imports no runner, adapter, codec or experiment verifier; reconstructs payload/wire bytes, schedule, byte totals, summaries and receipt chains from retained artifacts. Frozen standalone verifier also passes.
report_review_correction: Qualified the smallest-frame overhead explanation as unisolated rather than an observed causal fact. Original report/manifest retained in review-history. No frozen-source, raw-result or numerical change.
limitations: Only same-host synthetic frame delivery-and-ACK evidence; no household-device, mesh, cross-host, throughput, model or efficacy conclusion.
Ten paired batch observations per case per run, not independent hosts; no population significance or causal decomposition.
Integrity verification checks retained evidence and external admission chain, not malicious-producer honesty.
Execution order and retained complete artifacts agree; absence of undisclosed external runs cannot be proved from artifact contents alone.
